int_name: N 7TH ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the environment lacks modern safety enhancements like curb extensions, and parked vehicles near the corner may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction (Daylighting)
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb of the side street to the left of the church.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns into the side street.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner in front of the church entrance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder markings.

result.summary: The street environment provides continuous sidewalks but lacks essential crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices at the intersection. The wide, open roadway and parked vehicles along the curb create a hostile environment for pedestrians by encouraging higher speeds and obstructing sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated or protected space.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow or provide gaps for pedestrians to cross safely.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide residential/commercial corridor.
